name: EthSwt
description: Configuration of the EthSwt (Ethernet Switch Driver) module.

children.name: EthSwtDemEventParameterRefs
children.description: Container for the references to DemEventParameter elements which shall be invoked using the API Dem_ReportErrorStatus in case the corresponding error occurs. The EventId is taken from the referenced DemEventParameter's DemEventId value. The standardized errors are provided in the container and can be extended by vendor specific error references.

children.name: ETHSWT_E_ACCESS
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter which shall be issued when the error "Ethernet Switch Access Failure" has occurred.

metadata.LITERALS: ETHSWT_NOT_SENT AUTOSAR_ECUC ETHSWT_SENT_TAGGED AUTOSAR_ECUC ETHSWT_SENT_UNTAGGED AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: EthSwtPortIngress
children.description: Configuration of one Ethernet Switch Port ingress behavior.

children.name: EthSwtPortIngressVlanModification
children.description: If this parameter is defined all messages which arrive at this ingress port will be tagged with this VLAN Id. This tagging happen also if the arriving message already has a VLAN Id, it will be overwritten by the defined one.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If this parameter is not defined no changes to the VLAN Id shall happen at this ingress port.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: EthSwtPortTrafficClassAssignment
children.description: If this parameter is defined all arriving messages at this ingress port shall be assigned this traffic class.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If this parameter is not defined no general port based traffic class assignment is done.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: EthSwtPriorityRegeneration
children.description: Defines a priority regeneration where the EthSwtPriorityRegenerationIngressPriority is replaced by EthSwtPriorityRegenerationRegeneratedPriority.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The EthSwtPriorityRegeneration is optional in case no priority regeneration shall be performed. In case a EthSwtPriorityRegeneration is defined it shall have 8 mappings, one for each priority.

children.name: EthSwtPriorityRegenerationIngressPriority
children.description: Message priority of the incoming message.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: EthSwtPriorityRegenerationRegeneratedPriority
children.description: Message priority the incoming message will be tagged with.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: EthSwtPriorityTrafficClassAssignment
children.description: Defines a priority based traffic class assignment. All messages with a specific priority (EthSwtPriorityTrafficClassAssignmentPriority) arriving at this ingress port or, if enabled regenerated priorities (EthSwtPriorityRegeneration), shall be assigned to a traffic class (EthSwtPriorityTrafficClassAssignmentTrafficClass).

children.name: EthSwtPriorityTrafficClassAssignmentPriority
children.description: Message priority.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: EthSwtPriorityTrafficClassAssignmentTrafficClass
children.description: Traffic Class value.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: EthSwtSpi
children.description: Configuration of one Ethernet Switch SPI access (if SPI is used).

children.name: EthSwtSpiSequence
children.description: Container gives EthSwt driver information about one SPI sequence.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: One SPI sequence used by EthSwt driver is in exclusive use for it. No other driver is allowed to access this sequence. EthSwt driver may use one sequence to access n EthSwt hardware chips of the same type or n sequences are used to access one single EthSwt hardware chip. If a EthSwt hardware has no SPI interface, there is no instance of this container.

children.name: EthSwtSpiAccessSynchronous
children.description: This parameter is used to define whether the access to the Spi sequence is synchronous or asynchronous.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: SPI access is synchronous. false: SPI access is asynchronous.
